rows.gloss: hair twisted together; fibrous root, root
rows.etymology: 5086 jáṭā f. 'hair twisted together' PārGr̥., 'fibrous root, root' Bhpr. 2. *jaṭṭa-¹. 3. *jāṭā-. [Cf. śaṭā- f. 'ascetic's matted hair' W., saṭā- f. 'braid of hair, lion's mane' MBh. — DED 1897 and EWA i 413 ← Drav., but eventually with PMWS 63 ← Mu. with *jatta- (*jatra-, *jacca-), *jakka- (*jagga-), jūṭa- (*juṇṭa-), *jhaṇṭa- (*jhāṭṭha-, *jhiṇṭa-), *jhuṇṭa- (*jhōṇṭa-, *jhuṭṭa-, *jhūṭa-, *jhōṭṭa-), *jhūśa-, *jhallā-, cū́ḍa-¹ (cōḍa-³, *cōṇḍa-, *cōṭṭa-, *cunda-²)]
